Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a reduced license fee for personal use trailers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to small trailer license fees; adding a new sectionto chapter 46.16 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In lieu of the license tab fees provided in RCW 46.16.0621, privateuse singleaxle trailers of two thousand pounds scale weight or lessmay be licensed upon the payment of a license fee in the sum of fifteendollars, but only if the trailer is operated upon public highways. Thelicense fee must be collected annually for each registration year orfraction of a registration year. This reduced license fee applies onlyto trailers operated for personal use of the owners, and not trailersheld for rental to the public or used in any commercial or businessendeavor. The fee from this section must be deposited in the statepatrol highway account.
This act is effective with registration fees p. 1 SSB 6110that are due or will become due October 1, 2004, and thereafter.
